about_credit_lx: The original LX Music, this project is based on it
about_credit_lxx: LX-X Music: source of failure fallback, bg opacity/blur, keep screen on, quality badge and WebDAV auto backup features
about_notice_free: This project has no paid features and will never limit functionality behind payment, recharge or membership, nor package ordinary things as so-called "premium features" for money.
about_notice_scope: This project is developed, tested and discussed only on GitHub and in our internal test group. There is no official promotion or release on any other channel, group, official account, website or platform.
about_sponsor_greet: Thanks to everyone who supports this software.
about_sponsor_invite: If this software helps you, you are welcome to support its continued development and maintenance through sponsorship.

QQ Music and Kugou have no public account API (they need g_tk / client signatures with strict risk control), so there is no fake login form here.
Search, playlists and charts work without login; to open the private playlists in your account, fill in a cookie in Platform settings.

setting_basic_always_keep_statusbar_heig: By default, the app dynamically determines whether spacing needs to be kept for the system status bar, but if there is a situation on your device where the app's interactable content overlaps with the display of the status bar content, you can enable this option to always keep space for the system status bar.
setting_basic_auto_hide_play_bar: Hide playbar when keyboard pops up
setting_basic_home_page_scroll: Allow horizontal scrolling on vertical homepage

setting_basic_use_system_file_selector_t:
When this option is enabled, operations such as importing backup files, Music APIs, etc. will not need to request storage permissions, but may not be available on some systems.

You can turn off the option to fallback to the app's built-in file selector if you are unable to import files after enabling the option.
setting_cloud_sync_create_confirm: A new space will be created on the sync service and its code/secret filled in here. Enter the same values on the desktop app.
setting_cloud_sync_push_all_confirm: Upload all local playlists and settings as the newest version. This overwrites same-named playlists in the cloud. Use it only on first setup or when this device is the source of truth.
setting_cloud_sync_reset_confirm: This device will stop syncing and the code/secret will be removed locally. Local data is kept and nothing is deleted in the cloud.
setting_cloud_sync_tip: Use the same sync code and secret on your phone and computer to share playlists and settings. Each device uploads only what it changed.
setting_dislike_list_tips:
1. One line per entry. If there is an "@" symbol in the name of the song or artist, it needs to be replaced with "#"
2. Specify a song by a certain artist: song_name@artist_name
3. Specify a song: song_name
4. Specify an artist: @artist_name
setting_download_concurrency_tip: Number of songs downloaded at the same time (1-5). Use 2 on unstable networks.
setting_download_path_auto: Automatic (system Download folder, app private folder if not writable)
setting_download_path_tip: Only affects new downloads. Already downloaded files are not moved.
setting_download_path_unavailable: The custom download folder is not writable (deleted or no permission), using the automatic folder instead
setting_download_quality_tip: Auto: each song downloads at its own best available quality. Fixed: all songs use the selected level; songs without that level fall back automatically instead of failing the whole batch.
setting_download_save_lrc_tip: Save a same-name .lrc lyric file next to the downloaded song
setting_download_write_embed_lyric_tip: Lyrics are written into the audio file, no separate .lrc needed
setting_download_write_metadata_tip: Write title, artist and album into the audio file so other players show the right info
setting_list_add_music_location_type: Position When Adding a Song to the List
setting_list_click_action: Automatically switch to current list when clicking a song in the list (Only valid for "Playlists" and "Charts" page)

setting_local_music_no_permission: Storage / audio permission denied, unable to scan local music

setting_local_music_tip: Scan audio files under device Music / Download folders (mp3 / flac / wav / ape / m4a ...) into a "Local Music" playlist
setting_lyric_desktop_permission_tip:
To use this feature, you need to grant LX Mod the permission to display hover windows in the system permission settings.

Do you go to the relevant page to grant this permission?
setting_other_cache: Cache Management (including the cache of songs, lyrics, error logs, etc., it is not recommended to clean up if there is no problem related to song playback)
setting_other_cache_size: The app has used cache size:
setting_play_audio_offload_tip:
You can enable this option to save power consumption, but on some devices there may be an issue where all songs prompt "Error loading music" or "Unable to play the whole song in full", this is due to a bug in the current system. 

For those experiencing this issue you can turn off the option and restart the app completely and try again.
setting_play_auto_clean_played_list_tip: In the shuffle mode, when switching between songs by clicking on a song in the same list as playlist, if "Automatically empty played list" is enabled, the songs in the list will participate in the random again.
setting_play_cache_size_save_tip: The cache is set and takes effect after restarting the app.
setting_play_failure_fallback: Fall back to local cache on failure
setting_play_failure_fallback_tip: When fetching the play URL fails, automatically play the same song from local downloads instead (ported from LX-X in 1.15)
setting_play_handle_audio_focus: Automatically pause playback when other apps playing sound
setting_play_handle_audio_focus_tip: Take effect after restarting the app
setting_play_keep_screen_on: Keep screen on in play page
setting_play_keep_screen_on_tip: Keep the screen on while on the play detail page (originally only the lyric page)
setting_play_play_quality: Prioritize Sound Quality for Playback If Available
setting_play_report_desc: Play counts, listening time and preferences. Stored on this device only.
setting_play_s2t: Convert Chinese lyrics that are playing to traditional
setting_play_show_bluetooth_full_lyric: Display complete Bluetooth lyrics (device support required)
setting_play_show_notification_image: Show album cover in notification bar
setting_player_island_lyric_tip: Show the current lyric line on the island / ongoing notification. Android 16+ renders it as a live update.
setting_player_lock_screen_denied: Cannot open system settings, please allow lock screen display manually
setting_player_lock_screen_tip: Show song info, lyrics and playback controls on the lock screen. Some ROMs (MIUI / HyperOS) require enabling "Show on lock screen" in system settings.
setting_player_song_notify_tip: Announce the song name and artist with system TTS when the track changes
setting_player_system_lyric_tip: Publish the whole timed lyric to the system with the ColorOS / OPlus lyricInfo contract, so the lock screen, AOD and island scroll and highlight it natively. The song title is no longer replaced by the current line.
setting_source_test: Source test (real max quality per platform)
setting_source_test_tip: Search one song per platform and probe each quality level to find the highest actually available one. Results depend on your source script and network.

songlist_open_input_tip:
1. Cross-service playlists are not supported. Please confirm whether the playlist to be opened corresponds to the current chosen service
2. If you encounter a playlist link that cannot be opened. Please send us your feedback
3. Unable to open Kugou playlist with playlist ID or link from lite edition, but support to open it with Kugou code or link from main edition
4. NetEase’s “Private Radar” playlists require a token to access. Tencent’s personal playlists require your profile be public to access. For details, see FAQ in software docs
